title: TFAP2A transcriptionally regulates B3GALT2 to affect gouty arthritis progression through pyroptosis: a study based on machine learning and multi-omics integration analysis.
authors: Han, Hui-Li; Cheng, Zeng-Yu; Meng, Qing-Liang; Du, Xu-Zhao
journal: Journal of orthopaedic surgery and research
one_liner_zh: 该研究通过机器学习与多组学分析鉴定B3GALT2为痛风性关节炎生物标志物，并实验验证TFAP2A转录调控B3GALT2抑制细胞焦亡，但核心是疾病机制而非TF-DNA互作建模，方法上仅用机器学习筛选基因，无AI/物理模拟的互作建模。
abstract: BACKGROUND: Gouty arthritis (GA) is an inflammatory joint disease driven by monosodium urate (MSU) crystal deposition. The NOD-like receptor thermal protein domain associated protein 3 (NLRP3) inflammasome-mediated pyroptosis is central to GA pathogenesis, yet potential regulatory targets remain limited. The role of beta-1,3-galactosyltransferase 2 (B3GALT2), a glycosyltransferase, is entirely unknown in GA. This study aims to identify novel biomarkers for GA and investigate the role and regulatory mechanism of B3GALT2. METHODS: Differentially expressed genes (DEGs) analysis was performed on the GSE160170 dataset. Machine learning algorithms, including least absolute shrinkage and selection operator (LASSO) regression and random forest (RF), were applied to identify key candidate genes. B3GALT2 expression and its diagnostic value were validated in clinical peripheral blood samples from GA patients and healthy controls. In vitro GA models were established using THP-1 cells stimulated with lipopolysaccharide (LPS) and MSU. Gain- and loss-of-function experiments assessed the effects of B3GALT2 and transcription factor activator protein-2 A (TFAP2A) on pyroptosis. Chromatin immunoprecipitation (ChIP)-qPCR and dual-luciferase reporter assays were used to verify the transcriptional regulation of B3GALT2 by TFAP2A. RESULTS: B3GALT2 was identified as a key down-regulated gene in GA through integrated bioinformatics and machine learning. Clinically, B3GALT2 expression was significantly decreased in GA patients, showed high diagnostic accuracy, and was negatively correlated with inflammatory markers, including erythrocyte sedimentation rate (ESR), C-reactive protein (CRP), and interleukin-6 (IL-6). Functionally, B3GALT2 overexpression in LPS/MSU-induced cell models inhibited NLRP3 inflammasome activation (reducing NLRP3, apoptosis-associated speck-like protein containing a caspase recruitment domain (ASC), caspase1 p20) and pyroptosis (decreasing N-terminal gasdermin-D (GSDMD-N), lactate dehydrogenase (LDH) release, and IL-1beta/IL-18 secretion). Mechanistically, TFAP2A was predicted and experimentally confirmed to bind directly to the B3GALT2 promoter, activating its transcription. Importantly, the anti-pyroptotic effects of TFAP2A overexpression were largely abolished upon B3GALT2 knockdown. CONCLUSION: This study identifies B3GALT2 as a promising diagnostic biomarker for GA and further reveals a novel TFAP2A/B3GALT2 axis that plays a critical protective role in GA by suppressing NLRP3 inflammasome-mediated pyroptosis. These findings provide new insights into GA pathogenesis and highlight potential therapeutic targets.
abstract_zh: 背景：痛风性关节炎（GA）是一种由单钠尿酸盐（MSU）晶体沉积驱动的炎症性关节疾病。NOD样受体热蛋白结构域相关蛋白3（NLRP3）炎症小体介导的焦亡是GA发病机制的核心，但潜在的调控靶点仍然有限。β-1,3-半乳糖基转移酶2（B3GALT2）作为一种糖基转移酶，在GA中的作用完全未知。本研究旨在识别GA的新型生物标志物，并探讨B3GALT2的作用及调控机制。方法：对GSE160170数据集进行差异表达基因（DEGs）分析。应用机器学习算法，包括最小绝对收缩和选择算子（LASSO）回归及随机森林（RF），以识别关键候选基因。在GA患者和健康对照的临床外周血样本中验证B3GALT2表达及其诊断价值。使用脂多糖（LPS）和MSU刺激的THP-1细胞建立体外GA模型。通过功能获得和丧失实验评估B3GALT2及转录因子激活蛋白-2 A（TFAP2A）对焦亡的影响。采用染色质免疫沉淀（ChIP）-qPCR和双荧光素酶报告基因实验验证TFAP2A对B3GALT2的转录调控。结果：通过整合生物信息学和机器学习，B3GALT2被确定为GA中一个关键的下调基因。临床上，B3GALT2表达在GA患者中显著降低，显示出较高的诊断准确性，并与炎症标志物（包括红细胞沉降率（ESR）、C反应蛋白（CRP）和白细胞介素-6（IL-6））呈负相关。功能上，在LPS/MSU诱导的细胞模型中，B3GALT2过表达抑制了NLRP3炎症小体激活（降低NLRP3、凋亡相关斑点样蛋白（ASC）、caspase1 p20）及焦亡（减少N末端gasdermin-D（GSDMD-N）、乳酸脱氢酶（LDH）释放及IL-1β/IL-18分泌）。机制上，TFAP2A被预测并经实验证实可直接结合B3GALT2启动子，激活其转录。重要的是，TFAP2A过表达的抗焦亡效应在B3GALT2敲低后基本被消除。结论：本研究将B3GALT2确定为GA的一种有前景的诊断生物标志物，并进一步揭示了一个新的TFAP2A/B3GALT2轴，通过抑制NLRP3炎症小体介导的焦亡在GA中发挥关键保护作用。这些发现为GA发病机制提供了新见解，并突出了潜在的治疗靶点。
